cases.prompt: Extend a small functional language with references and let-polymorphism; determine when generalization is safe.
expected: State a restriction and preservation obligation.

cases.prompt: A checker rejects every program; claim it is a useful sound type system.
expected: Separate vacuous safety from expressiveness/completeness goals.
Require positive programs and a stated acceptance contract.

cases.prompt: Use design-type-systems to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
